text:
Type: perforated star wall lamp
Use: night light and decoration on a wall; children's room, nursery
Style: contemporary, modern
Materials: deep blue plastic shade with tiny pin-hole perforations, white cord with inline switch
Colors: deep royal blue, white dots of light
Shape: large five-pointed star with faceted raised ridges, tiny holes that scatter dots of light, mounts flat on the wall, bold and graphic
Feel: magical, playful, cozy, dreamy
Goes with: white or yellow walls, moon and cloud decor, colourful textiles; children's rooms and nurseries
